name: train-pending-and-nothing-to-cut
why: The two silences a train read produces on purpose, pinned so a reader cannot mistake either for a signal it forgot to read. acme/quiet has a run still in progress on its default branch and one docs commit past its tag: pending is not red, and a tail that would cut no release is not unreleased work (release is not an act anyone can take on a docs commit), so it raises nothing. acme/nocheck has no checks at all, which reads unknown rather than a green it never earned, and raises nothing either. acme/ready is the contrast: a green branch with a tail the train would cut is exactly one unreleased row. A train that could not be read at all is not in any position; the sweep reports it beside the queue as unchecked, by signal, and these three were read.

expected.detail: 2 unreleased commit(s); next would cut v2.2.0
